context_requirements: Expression of soluble guanylyl cyclase subunits (GUCY1A2/A3, GUCY1B3) or other guanylyl cyclase isoforms
Intact cGMP effector pathways (PKG, cGMP-gated channels, phosphodiesterases)
Presence of nitric oxide or carbon monoxide for heme-dependent activation, or direct heme-independent activation
HIF-1α stabilization capacity for secondary transcriptional effects
falsifiers: No change in HIF1A or canonical HIF target genes (VEGFA, EDN1, BNIP3, DDIT4) at 6 or 24 h in any responsive line
No cGMP-dependent gene expression signature (e.g., no induction of EGR1, FOS, JUN) across all lines
Uniform strong proliferation arrest or apoptosis in all nine lines at 6 h, inconsistent with slow cGMP-mediated transcription
Lack of any transcriptional response (kinetics 'none') in lines known to express guanylyl cyclases (e.g., A549, HEPG2, PC3)
